npcs.label: Player Upgrades
npcs.issue: The torso, coat, hands, and tool drift together; the cylinder never becomes the idea.
npcs.proposal: Inspect cylinder, catch a goggle glint, adjust, then return through a clean settle.
npcs.secondary: Coat hem and belt tools trail the hand by two to three frames.

npcs.label: Gear Merchant
npcs.issue: The pack and miner move as one rigid card; the lamp pulse has no physical cause.
npcs.proposal: Shift the heavy pack through the shoulder strap, check the lamp, then replant the weight.
npcs.secondary: Beard, pickaxe, bottles, and hanging tools settle in descending weight order.

npcs.label: Bobo Merchant
npcs.issue: Pleasant motion, but the silhouette stays generic and the dog personality is quiet at game scale.
npcs.proposal: Curious sniff and head tilt, ear response, two tail beats, then a soft relaxed return.
npcs.secondary: Backpack bottle and paw medallion answer the tail with a short delayed swing.

npcs.label: Money Monster
npcs.issue: The loop is technically smooth, but the coin, eye, and pouch do not form a readable greedy beat.
npcs.proposal: Track and roll the coin, give one sly squint, let the pouch and loose coins answer, then settle.
npcs.secondary: Coin glint leads; necklace and purse land later without moving the planted feet.

npcs.label: Gem Power Merchant
npcs.issue: A global purple pulse makes every crystal react together, flattening scale and hierarchy.
npcs.proposal: Charge the staff first; move light through eyes, chest, shoulder cluster, and satchel in sequence.
npcs.secondary: A heavy stone-body compression and delayed crystal shimmer close the loop.

npcs.label: Magma Money Monster
npcs.issue: This active merchant has no idle video key, so it is the only fully motionless merchant.
npcs.proposal: Dip the gold scale pan, flare the furnace cracks and eye, then let chest and coins absorb the weight.
npcs.secondary: Ember intensity decays before the hanging metal finishes its settle.
